steps.name: loraweight-seat-w10
argv: THE TRIGGER'S VOLUME KNOB at lora-weight 1.0, and it is the ONE variable against the ladder's b2-seat-s1. That cell held the seat and lost his skin, and lora-jerry-v3-capshape-0822 has already ruled out prompt dialect -- a caption-shaped prompt came back tan with the seat still held -- and lora-jerry-v3-cnetscale-0822 has ruled out hint volume, with --scale 0.7 AND 0.5 both tan and both still seated. This is the mirror: round seven turned the LoRA DOWN and the hint UP because v2's trigger was overriding the pose; v3 inverts the tension, so the untried direction is the trigger UP. Same checkpoint and sha, same seat skeleton at scale 1.0, same seed 20260822, same prompt.txt and negative.txt, 40 steps, cfg 7.5, strength 1.0, --pad-crop 0, --blur 0. WHAT A PASS LOOKS LIKE: desaturated sage skin AND the knees still up. Either one alone is not a pass -- a sage standing goblin is what v2 already gives. AND EVEN A PASS IS CONDITIONAL: B3 already fails at 0.8 against its no-LoRA twin (hair brown -> blue-grey), and a weight above 0.8 makes that worse, so this can only ever settle B2 and must be reconciled against B3 before it becomes a recipe.

steps.name: publish
argv:
import hashlib, glob, os, shutil
OUT = "C:/banyan-farm/lora-jerry-v3-loraweight-0822/out"
DST = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/lora-jerry-v3-loraweight-0822"
os.makedirs(DST, exist_ok=True)
n = 0
found = sorted(glob.glob(OUT + "/*.png")) + sorted(
    glob.glob(OUT + "/*.png.meta.yaml"))
for p in found:
    if os.path.isfile(p):
        shutil.copyfile(p, os.path.join(DST, os.path.basename(p)))
        n += 1
with open(os.path.join(DST, "lora-jerry-v3-loraweight-0822.sha256"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for name in sorted(os.listdir(DST)):
        q = os.path.join(DST, name)
        if os.path.isfile(q) and not name.endswith(".sha256"):
            fh.write("%s  %s" % (
                hashlib.sha256(open(q, "rb").read()).hexdigest(), name) + chr(10))
print("published", n, "file(s) ->", DST, flush=True)
if n == 0:
    raise SystemExit("NOTHING TO PUBLISH -- the ladder produced no files")
